organization.name: Safe Cycle Tech
organization.mission: Collect unwanted electronics, refurbish what can be saved for local students and families, and responsibly recycle the rest.
organization.voice: Neighborly, practical, trustworthy, specific, and never pushy.
facts: Pickup is free across the Bay Area.
Working devices are refurbished for local students and underprivileged families.
Drives are wiped to NIST 800-88 standards or physically destroyed when wiping is not possible.
Equipment that cannot be refurbished goes to certified California electronics recyclers.
Safe Cycle Tech accepts broken phones, laptops, desktop computers, tablets, monitors, DVRs, game consoles, routers, cables, and most other electronics.
prohibitedClaims: Do not invent impact numbers, partnerships, certifications, testimonials, or recipient stories.
Do not identify students, families, or donors without explicit written permission.
Do not claim every donated device is refurbished; unusable equipment is responsibly recycled.
Do not promise a pickup window, price, or tax outcome that has not been confirmed.
organization.cta:
Check out https://safecycletech.com to learn more about our organization and how we’re helping the community.

Call or text (415) 612-8520 or email pickup@safecycletech.com to schedule a pickup.

platforms.label: Any platform
platforms.note: Platform-neutral copy. Paste it into whatever you are posting to.
platforms.guidance: Platform-neutral. Assume nothing about the audience or the interface: no hashtags unless they read naturally in a sentence, no references to features only one network has, no 'link in bio'.

platforms.label: Reddit
platforms.note: Check the subreddit's self-promotion and flair rules before posting.
platforms.guidance: Community-first, specific, transparent, and adapted to each subreddit's rules.

platforms.label: Facebook
platforms.note: Post from the Page or Meta Business Suite, not a personal profile.
platforms.guidance: Warm and informative with a clear local call to action.

platforms.label: Nextdoor
